Synopsis:
Halsin's default dialogue at camp once he's joined you as a follower. You can ask how he's faring in your company, as well as glean some details about your next quest. Halsin is avuncular and scholarly, but his mood grows darker whenever he speaks of Moonrise Towers and the curse that has shrouded it.Once Thaniel, the spirit of the land, has been rescued and brought to camp, a new branch will unlock where Halsin can explain that Thaniel's heart is missing, and it needs to be retrieved in order for the Shadow curse to be lifted. Halsin can be recruited as a companion 11from then on.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Halsin2.json: Thaniel — the spirit of the land — has already been rescued and is resting in your camp, but he is not whole: Halsin has discovered the Shadow curse tore him in two, leaving one corrupted fragment behind in the mortal realm while the other was dragged toward the Shadowfell. Halsin, an avuncular scholar whose mood darkens when he speaks of Moonrise Towers and the curse, explains that the missing half may be twisted and dangerous but should still bear signs of Thaniel’s power (he suggests looking for life — wildflowers — in the darkness). He also mentions a promising lead: a ruin outside Last Light where he saw fresh blooms and will mark your map. Halsin offers his aid and can be recruited as a companion to help you find and restore Thaniel.
- SCE_Halsin.json: Dialogue with Halsin in the epilogue of Act 2. In it, he reacts to the various states that could occur in relation to his desire to rid the Act 2 region of the shadow curse:- if you've already done everything needed to ensure success. he's grateful and seeks to remain with you on the journey to Baldur's Gate.- if the curse is not yet sure to be lifted, but there's still something that can be done (ie Thaniel was saved from the Shadowfell, but hasn't been fully restored), he will implore the players to help and offer to join them.- if it's no longer possible to lift the curse, Halsin is sad and resigned to staying behind to stand sentry over it. He will not be available as a companion in Act 3, and his story effectively ends here.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Spirit.json: The player tries to interact with Thaniel, the spirit of the land, after Halsin rescues him from the Shadowfell. Thaniel is unconscious/unresponsive however.Later - Thaniel is recovering and able to talk. A somewhat otherworldly, wise far beyond his years 'child'. He instructs you on what comes next/offers his thanks once you have succeeded.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Portal.json: After the player acquires Art's instrument from the Surgeon, and speaks to Art, Halsin is able to use information given by Art to navigate through the Shadowfell, with the intention of recuing Thaniel, the spirit of the land, and ultimately lifting the shadow curse. He asks the player to help him by protecting a portal to the Shadowfell until he can return with Thaniel. He waits by the shore a short distance from Last Light. Once Halsin enters the portal and the dialogue ends, shadow creatures attack. The player must fight off the creatures until Halsin returns. However, if the player attempts to go through the portal themselves, the ritual will fail.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_PortalEntry.json: Halsin has been conducting a ritual to open a portal to the Shadowfell while the player defends him from attacking shadows. In this case, the player interfered with the portal (trying to enter it themselves) causing it to collapse. Halsin reacts, aghast. His one chance to infiltrate the Shadowfell and lift the shadow curse has been lost. He expresses his anger to the player and walks off. Ultimately he will part ways from us for good sometime soon after.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Halsin: Thaniel is resting - but it's no easy slumber. I discovered what's wrong with him. (node 93)
- Halsin: The shadows rended him in two when they bore him away to the Shadowfell. Half of his essence remained here, amidst the curse. (node 96)
- Halsin: What stayed behind would have been the strongest part of him, but after all these years left in darkness, corruption must have taken hold. (node 63)
- Player: Tell me how I can help. (node 4)
- Halsin: It's both simple and not - we need to find Thaniel's missing half, and make him whole again. (node 31)
- Halsin: Only, the missing half may not come willingly. The curse will have sunk its tendrils deep, twisting Thaniel's essence into something... else. || [context] NodeContext: Some foreboding (node 152)
- Player: Any ideas on how to find this missing half? (node 209)
- Halsin: No matter how it's been twisted by the shadows, it is still part of Thaniel's essence - it will resemble him somehow, and may show signs of his power. (node 148)
- Halsin: Look for signs of life in the darkness. Wildflowers, where everything else is dead. The curse cannot subdue the power Thaniel bears. Not entirely. || [context] NodeContext: Grave. They'll have to effectively kill a child to save a child. (node 107)
- Halsin: In fact, I saw just the sort before, not long after we first came within reach of the shadow curse. Fool that I am, I did not grasp their significance at the time. || [context] NodeContext: Moment of realisation. Kicking himself a bit for not putting 2 + 2 together earlier (node 136)
- Halsin: There is a ruin, some way outside of Last Light. I caught a glimpse of fresh blooms there, but did not investigate further. I shall mark it upon your map. || [context] NodeContext: Eager/determined. They have a promising lead (node 118)
- Player: All right, leave it to me. (node 265)

- Halsin: If you want me, I'm yours. Against the curse, against the Absolute - anything. Just say the word. || [context] NodeContext: Stalwart, heartfelt (node 192)
- Player: Join me. (node 77)
- Halsin: Good. Now our roots can deepen - together. (node 131)

context: Halsin is an avuncular, scholarly druid who has joined your camp as a follower; his tone grows darker when he speaks of Moonrise Towers and the Shadow curse. Thaniel, the land’s spirit, has been rescued and is resting in camp but is not whole — the shadows tore him in two, leaving one corrupted fragment behind while the other was dragged toward the Shadowfell. Halsin believes the missing half may be twisted and dangerous but should still show traces of Thaniel’s power (he suggests looking for signs of life—wildflowers—in the darkness) and says he glimpsed such blooms at a ruin outside Last Light and will mark it on your map. He offers his aid and can be recruited as a companion to help find and restore Thaniel.
